lanes.VERIFIED_VAULT: Evidence-bound machine recipe templates. Verification is scoped to template mechanics and exact source bindings; it is not arbitrary generated-source correctness.
lanes.PATTERN_NURSERY: Frequently observed structural/edit patterns generalized from caller-supplied evidence. Frequency creates candidates only and never self-promotes.

fastUse.normalMachine: Exact language/intent/binding index -> deterministic template capsule -> typed-hole instance -> renderer/execution held unless separately bound.
fastUse.ai: Same template identity -> compact constraint capsule -> AI may propose source -> proposal must return to language-native verification.

mining.inputs: caller-supplied normalized structural/edit observations with provenance digests
mining.method: deterministic grouping plus anti-unification-style structural holes
